title: From Kharkiv Noodles to a Dry Island off Nha Trang
industry: food (instant noodles), then property and hotels
conflicts: Founding year 1993 (Vingroup's own date via VietnamFinance and VietNamNet; Kyiv Post 2003) versus 1995 for Technocom (Inventure/Ekonomichna Pravda); 1995 is used only for the Mivina brand. Sale to Nestle in 2010 for about $150 million (four sources) versus a 2009 transfer with no buyer named (VietnamFinance); the story says 'around 2010' and 'a reported $150 million'. Start-up loan of 'a few thousand dollars' from friends versus about $10,000 from family; the conservative figure is used. Workforce later 3,000 versus about 1,900, and 97% market share versus 97% of consumers; neither figure is used.
notes: Country set to Vietnam (region Southeast Asia) because the change of direction, the Hon Tre resort and Vincom, happened there; the slate had Ukraine with Southeast Asia, which do not match. Vuong gives few interviews and none in English on this decision was found; his own statements come from Vietnamese reporting and are paraphrased, not quoted. Several sources are Vietnamese-language national outlets.
